name: West End Management & Leasing
body: "One of the largest" PM companies in the metro. Pays-on-performance model (no fee until a tenant is approved). Leans hard on trust guarantees rather than price.
extra: 5 guarantees: Stress-Free Rent Pledge ($1,000 eviction cost coverage), Pet Damage Coverage, Price Match, Happiness Guarantee (cancel anytime), Fee Transparency Pledge.
ads: No active Meta ads found (checked Sep 11, 2026).

name: Deca Property Management
body: Dedicated team per owner (manager + assistant + field rep) and an in-house maintenance division ("Aced Maintenance"). Positions on scale and personal service at once.
extra: 3 guarantees: Lease Time Promise, Pet Damage Promise, Eviction Promise.
ads: Actively running ~10 Meta/Instagram ads — every one is a vacant rental listing aimed at tenants. Zero landlord-acquisition ads.

name: Eaton Properties
body: Tech-forward positioning: web portal for owners/tenants, electronic payments, online work orders. Frames the pitch as turning ownership into "passive income."
extra: No guarantee advertised. A Yelp review describes a months-long unresolved ceiling leak/water damage — directly at odds with the fast-response positioning.
ads: No active Meta ads found under the business name (checked Sep 11, 2026).

metrics.note: No clear aggregate rating published; their Facebook page name doesn't match the business name cleanly in search, so follower count wasn't verifiable this pass.

name: Homestretch Property Management
body: Pitches a flat-rate, "no surprise fees" structure and a single dedicated local manager as the point of contact. Lists on 30+ platforms for faster leasing.
extra: No guarantee advertised. Offers a free rental analysis as their lead magnet — same convention Full Scope already uses. One recurring complaint found: applicants must join a non-optional $50/month "rewards" program just to apply.
ads: Not checked yet in this pass — worth a follow-up.

name: Evernest (national)
body: "National Brand, Local People." A large, VC-backed national property management company actively acquiring independent local firms across the U.S. — a consolidation trend worth knowing about beyond just its ads.
extra: 3 guarantees: Maintenance Guarantee, Resident Eviction Guarantee (free re-lease), 100% Happiness Guarantee.
ads: Ad Library search inconclusive — name collides with unrelated companies. Not conclusively checked.

metrics.note: Mixed signal: BBB/Trustpilot reviews contrast sharply with claimed 5-star Google reviews (per a BiggerPockets forum discussion questioning the discrepancy) — worth treating their online rating with skepticism rather than citing a number.
